01

CanSat Design Challenge

2025–2026

Software Lead / Python, PyTorch

Computer vision, sensor processing, and mission software for a rocket-launched CanSat, built around compute, memory, and power constraints.

more about this project +
  • Adapted TerrainMesh's graph neural network for aerial 3D reconstruction and Raspberry Pi inference, investigating failures in blurred and degraded images with guidance from a Google DeepMind mentor.
  • Built paired RGB/elevation preprocessing, sparse-depth sampling, and augmentations for scale, blur, lighting, and camera quality.
  • Coordinated delivery for a University of Alberta research presentation. Our team received the Educational Outreach Award at the Canada-wide challenge.

Mayhem

multiplayer game

Development Lead / Lua / Luau

A multiplayer party FPS with unusual weapons and abilities. Built with a 12-person team across code, art, animation, and music, and played by over 200 players.

more about this project +

03

Compact AI Text Detectors

2026

Independent CS229 Project / Python, PyTorch

Investigating compact AI-text detection with matched human and AI responses, aiming to avoid shortcuts based on topic alone.

more about this project +

Built a CNN pairwise ranker and covariance-based classifier, then extended the ranker with HMM/Viterbi decoding to segment mixed human and AI authorship.
